Strategy: Five tiers: exact fits, leftovers holding one more item, then two more, then roomy ones, then dead ones. Tier bonuses of one item, half an item, or none keep tiers apart while tightness orders bins inside a tier, so ranking can switch from Best Fit when a looser bin sits in a better tier. It may help by preferring leftovers holding few more items, but may fail by demoting a nearly exact dead leftover below all usable bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mx = max(bins)
    return [(0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + item if item <= r - item < item * 2 else (-(r - item) + item / 2 if item * 2 <= r - item < item * 3 else (-(r - item) if r - item >= item * 3 else -(r - item) - mx)))) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Five-tier lexicographic: exact > one-more band (+item) > two-more band (+item/2) > roomy > dead (-mx).
